findings.label: Bundled episode-fading changes
findings.detail: Commit 410f6792 also adds project_bootstrap_self, an isinstance guard in project_runtime_context, and a _same_json zip(strict=False) tweak that belong to the episode-fading work, not the three-branch audit-cut. Scope-hygiene note only; does not affect correctness of the audit-cut.

findings.label: Delta reconstruction test uses synthetic state
findings.detail: test_every_request_can_reconstruct_current_self_and_context validates apply_overlay/_read_self reconstruction over the projected shape but on a flat synthetic memory_state, not on the agent_mind/active_state/semantic nested-record branches. Per-function idempotency assertions cover the phantom-delta risk for those branches, so coverage is adequate; a reconstruction test over a realistic three-branch payload would close the gap directly.
